name: Grilled yard chicken
summary: Yard chicken rubbed with pounded lá ech and grilled so the skin goes golden without drying out. The dip is a forest salt. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 29 Aug 2016 describes Êđê and M’nông grilled chicken as one part of the jar-wine, bamboo-rice, and chicken set.
howToEat: The cook in buôn Kô Tam, quoted that day, says the bird is a yard chicken of any size, given a few mouthfuls of rượu cần before it is killed. After it drains, it is rubbed with pounded lá ech, a herb that heats fast on the coals so the meat cooks through. The skin is golden and not dry.

The same article pounds lá ech, lá giang, culantro, scallion, scallion bulb, and green chili with salt for the dip, and says lime leaf or rau răm may be there too. Eat it with the bamboo rice. When the salt bites, drink from the jar. A grill time and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Ko Tam community tourism area in Buon Ma Thuot, and Buon Tri A in Buon Don beside the Serepok. A street number is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ga nuong in Buon Ma Thuot — yard chicken and forest salt
seoDescription: Yard chicken rubbed with la ech and grilled, with a forest-salt dip and bamboo rice. Ko Tam and Buon Tri A are named. A price is Check on arrival.
